stemMd: A line has equation 3x + 2y = 12. What is its slope?
explanationMd: Solve for y: 2y = −3x + 12, so y = −(3/2)x + 6. The coefficient of x is the slope, −3/2. Intercepts and slopes are different quantities.

distractorRationale.e: This loses the minus sign when isolating y.
distractorRationale.d: This takes the reciprocal of the correct slope.
